title: [placeholder] Bounce
prompt: a ball bounces around the screen and you steer a paddle to keep it in play
source:
# bounce.8o - a ball bounces around the screen; steer a paddle to keep it in play.
# Mechanic: continuous motion, wall bounces, paddle hit test by comparing coordinates.
# Controls: key 4 (keyboard Q) = left, key 6 (keyboard E) = right.

:alias bx  v0   # ball x
:alias by  v1   # ball y
:alias dx  v2   # ball x direction: 0 = right, 1 = left
:alias dy  v3   # ball y direction: 0 = down,  1 = up
:alias px  v4   # paddle x (paddle is 8 wide, drawn at row 30)
:alias t   v5   # scratch
:alias one v6   # constant 1, so we can subtract with -=
:alias py  v7   # paddle y

: ball
  0xC0 0xC0
: paddle
  0xFF

# wait for 2 timer ticks (about 30 frames per second)
: tick
  t := 2
  delay := t
  loop
    t := delay
    while t != 0
  again
  return

# draw (or erase, since drawing is XOR) the ball and the paddle
: draw-all
  i := ball
  sprite bx by 2
  i := paddle
  sprite px py 1
  return

# keys move the paddle 2 pixels per frame
: move-paddle
  t := 4
  if t key begin
    if px != 0 then px -= one
    if px != 0 then px -= one
  end
  t := 6
  if t key begin
    if px != 56 then px += 1
    if px != 56 then px += 1
  end
  return

# the ball moves one pixel diagonally per frame and bounces off walls
: move-ball
  if dx == 0 then bx += 1
  if dx == 1 then bx -= one
  if bx == 62 then dx := 1
  if bx == 0  then dx := 0
  if dy == 0 then by += 1
  if dy == 1 then by -= one
  if by == 0 then dy := 0
  # the ball's bottom edge reaches the paddle row when by == 28
  if by == 28 begin
    if dy == 0 begin
      # hit if bx+2 >= px (ball right edge is not left of paddle)
      t := bx
      t += 2
      t -= px
      if vf == 1 begin
        # and px+8 >= bx (ball left edge is not right of paddle)
        t := px
        t += 8
        t -= bx
        if vf == 1 then dy := 1
      end
    end
  end
  # missed the paddle: serve again from the top
  if by == 30 begin
    by := 1
    dy := 0
  end
  return

: main
  one := 1
  py := 30
  bx := 20
  by := 4
  dx := 0
  dy := 0
  px := 28
  loop
    draw-all        # erase old position
    move-paddle
    move-ball
    draw-all        # draw new position
    tick
  again
